# Cheaper calibration (generated by scripts/cheap_calibration.py)

## Person by person

- ecg_finetune 3s vs unet: better for 16 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.322; Wilcoxon p = 3.05e-05
- ecg_finetune 5s vs unet: better for 16 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.341; Wilcoxon p = 3.05e-05
- ecg_finetune 10s vs unet: better for 16 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.350; Wilcoxon p = 3.05e-05
- beats_shift 10s vs unet: better for 12 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.114; Wilcoxon p = 0.011
- beats_shift 30s vs unet: better for 13 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.113; Wilcoxon p = 0.0155
- beats_pseudo 10s vs unet: better for 15 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.207; Wilcoxon p = 6.1e-05
- beats_pseudo 30s vs unet: better for 15 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.222; Wilcoxon p = 0.000153
- beats_pseudo 10s vs beats_shift 10s: better for 11 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.093; Wilcoxon p = 0.0654
- beats_pseudo 30s vs beats_shift 30s: better for 10 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.109; Wilcoxon p = 0.0654
- ecg_finetune 3s vs beats_pseudo 30s: better for 15 of 16 people; mean r difference +0.100; Wilcoxon p = 6.1e-05
- ecg_finetune 3s vs ecg_finetune 10s: better for 1 of 16 people; mean r difference -0.028; Wilcoxon p = 0.000153
